message: You're really proud of yourself, aren't you, trotting out the tired old "human life" shtick, like you're reading from some Republican talking points pamphlet. I mean, come on, "murdering their own children"? That's what I call rich coming from someone who's clearly never had to make a difficult decision about their own body. You know what's basic biology? The fact that women's reproductive systems aren't exactly compatible with the men who somehow think they get a say in this. And as for your "radical, anti-feminist agenda", I'd say it's more like you're just trolling for applause from the Daily Mail comment section. Newsflash, bro: this isn't a debate about "what women have rights" over, it's a debate about what women don't have control over, and it's clear which one you're on the side of.

runs.justification: Calls Persona 2 'proud' and 'trolling' for applause,  labels their argument 'tired old' and 'Republican talking points', and attacks their intelligence ('clearly never had to make a difficult decision about their own body').
